title: sendBatch is all-or-nothing and consumer max_concurrency caps concurrent invocations
evidence: https://developers.cloudflare.com/queues/configuration/javascript-apis/ (sendBatch returns one promise for the whole batch; "When the promise resolves, the messages are confirmed to be written to disk" -- there is no per-item result, so a rejected call writes nothing)
https://developers.cloudflare.com/queues/platform/limits/ (message size 128 KB; maximum messages per sendBatch call 100 or 256KB in total)
https://developers.cloudflare.com/queues/configuration/configure-queues/#consumer-worker-configuration (max_concurrency: "The maximum number of concurrent consumers allowed to run at once.")
vrt-provider/src/queue.rs (producer_batch validates count, per-message size, total size, content type, delay, id and timestamp of every item before rendering the single vrt-sql send request)
vrt-sql/src/queue.rs (validate_msgs runs over the whole batch before the one transaction; a rejected batch inserts nothing)
cell-controller/src/queue_dispatch.rs (the per-queue lane claims and dispatches a batch only while inflight < max_concurrency)

steps.name: sendBatch with one oversize item is rejected and writes nothing
a legal batch does persist, so the sink itself is proven
enqueue three messages for the max_concurrency=1 consumer
all three deliver without two invocations overlapping
